title: Inter-agency coordination on the 2026 Civil Grand Jury ALPR report response
summary:
Filed after the 2025-2026 San Mateo County Civil Grand Jury released "Is Our Flock of ALPR Cameras Properly Tended?" on 2026-08-03, with responses requested under Penal Code §§ 933 and 933.05. Covers 2026-08-03 through the date of production and expressly excludes SMPD's and the City's own internal draft responses.

- Item 1: communications — email, text, written correspondence — between the Department and any other law enforcement agency, city, town, the County, or the San Mateo County Police Chiefs and Sheriffs Association referencing the report or any agency's response to it.
- Item 2: calendar entries, meeting invitations, or agendas for any meeting or call listing the report or responses to it as a topic, plus any minutes or notes received or retained.
- Item 3: any draft response, response template, or model language received from another agency or association.

The request supplies illustrative search terms ("grand jury," "SMCCGJ," "Properly Tended," "933," "933.05") and offers an alternative search — messages exchanged with other agencies' or the association's email domains during the short covered period — without limiting the request to those terms.

policy_promises.quote: the governing body of the public agency shall comment to the presiding judge of the superior court on the findings and recommendations
policy_promises.tests: Whether responding agencies are coordinating their § 933 responses, and whether template or model language is circulating between them.

policy_promises.quote: Any reasonably segregable portion of a record shall be available for inspection
policy_promises.tests: Whether date, sender, recipients, and subject are produced for any communication withheld under a claimed exemption.

filed_because: The Grand Jury report requires responses from multiple agencies on a common deadline. Whether those responses are drafted independently or from shared template language materially changes how much weight any single agency's response carries. Asking during the drafting window, rather than after responses are filed, is what makes the coordination record obtainable.
notes:
Filed 2026-08-18; 10-day statutory determination due 2026-08-28.

Companion to W013266-081826, which asks the City side (tasking and schedule) rather than the inter-agency side. Deliberately scoped to received and exchanged records, not internal drafts, to avoid a deliberative-process denial swallowing the whole request.
